purpose: Teach: 爽快/ババ/チカ/取り込み/近かっ/つらく/こぎ/じゃう

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、運動後の爽快感、知ってる?気持ちいいよ。
lines.en: Sho, you know that feeling after you exercise? That fresh, clean rush? It's really nice.
lines.style: Warm and unhurried, like she's thinking out loud. Gentle invitation into her own memory. Soft pace, comfortable pauses between phrases.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん。お姉さんと、ババ抜き、また、しよう、メイ姉さん。
lines.en: Yeah. Um, can we play Old Maid again with you, Mei-sis?
lines.style: Quick bright spark at the start. Eager but polite — checking if she's asking too much. Small voice underneath the excitement, hopeful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 空のお星さま、チカチカ、光ってるね、綺麗。
lines.en: The stars in the sky are twinkling, aren't they? So pretty.
lines.style: Soft, drifting tone. Looking up. Peaceful observation, almost to herself. Breath settles at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、いま、取り込み中?後でいい、忙しい?
lines.en: Mei-sis, are you busy right now? Would later be okay?
lines.style: Tentative, careful of her time. Not quite whispering but restrained. Worried he's interrupting. Small and considerate.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんが小さい時、お家、もっと近かったよね、駅から。
lines.en: When you were little, Sho, our house was closer to the station, remember?
lines.style: Distant, reaching backward. Soft wonder tinged with something she's lost. Slight trail-off at the end, settling into the memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園で泣いてたら、お友達と、ケンカ、つらくなったの。
lines.en: I was crying in the park because I'd had a fight with a friend. It hurt.
lines.style: Quiet, careful with the past hurt. Trusting her with something tender. Slow, deliberate — each word weighted. Small voice underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ボート、ペダル、こぎ続けてみようね、頑張れ。
lines.en: We'll keep pedaling the boat together, okay? You can do it.
lines.style: Gentle encouragement, like she's steadying him. Warm and present. Steady pace, soft but sure. The kind of support that doesn't shout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祭りで、ジュース、全部飲んじゃうかな、ぼく。
lines.en: I'm going to drink all the shaved ice at the festival, I think.
lines.style: Small laugh underneath, lighter now. A little bit of himself returning. Eager and distracted in the sweetest way. Trailing off into the possibility.
